test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 27 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully and decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All kings have grey hair.

Some knights become kings.

**Conclusions:**

I: All knights have grey hair.

II: All grey haired knights are kings.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

solution:
**Statements:**

All kings have grey hair.

Some knights become kings.

**Possible Venn diagram:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/994c128ab3dfac33f9c708176047387b3596dd010e2c77aecf697e321cf2bff6.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I: All knights have grey hair →** False** (Since some knights become kings and all kings have grey hair)

II: All grey haired knights are kings →** False** (It may not be true because all grey haired knights are not kings)

Hence,** 'option 4'** is the correct answer.
